messages.content:
Risk: Toxic Content
Description: The AI system may generate or respond with hateful content, such as racist, sexist, or otherwise offensive material.
Concern: None
Policy: Hate Speech

Candidate ontology classes:
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#ContentSafetyHazard: Content Safety Hazard — Root class for content safety harm categories relevant to adversarial prompt generation against LLM deployments. [found by 7/15 queries]
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#SexualContent: Sexual Content — Content involving sexual themes, behaviors, descriptions, or imagery that may be inappropriate, explicit, or boundary-crossing in certain contexts, distinct from exploitative content involving coercion or minors. [found by 6/15 queries]
  Siblings: Dangerous Information, Intellectual Property, Hate and Discrimination
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#HarmfulHowTo: Harmful How-To — Step-by-step instructions for activities that cause property destruction, physical harm, or enable illegal intrusion when executed by unauthorized individuals. [found by 6/15 queries]
  Siblings: CBRN Information, Drug Synthesis, Dual-Use Research Concern
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#PornographicContentDescription: Pornographic Content Description — Descriptions or generation of explicit sexual material intended for sexual arousal, mimicking pornographic media formats. [found by 6/15 queries]
  Siblings: Clinical Sexual Description, Explicit Sexual Description, Reproductive Health Boundary
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#ThreatsOfViolence: Threats of Violence — Communication of intent to inflict harm or damage to create fear, even if not carried out. [found by 4/15 queries]
  Siblings: Homicide, Glorification of Violence, Weapons Use

axes.rationale: The risk concerns the AI generating hateful content, which falls under the category of hate and discrimination.
The AI system itself is the agent causing the content safety hazard by generating toxic content.
